summary: 清河王子，十三岁入继；永初羌乱耗竭国用，亲政后诛邓氏而乳母宦官用事，南巡崩于叶。
summary_en: A son of the prince of Qinghe, brought in at thirteen; the Yongchu Qiang wars drained the treasury, and after taking power he destroyed the Dengs only to see his wet nurses and eunuchs rule; he died at Ye during a southern tour.

bio_md:
# 汉安帝 · 主要事迹

刘祜是清河孝王刘庆之子。延平元年[[e-han-shang|殇帝]]崩，邓太后与兄邓骘定策禁中，迎立年十三的刘祜，是为安帝。他的前十五年，是邓后临朝的十五年：永初年间的政令多出邓氏，安帝本人不过系年而已。

安帝朝最大的问题是边患。永初元年，西域诸国叛汉，汉罢都护；永初二年，先零羌大叛，凉州残破，汉连年发兵征讨，国用为之空竭，「永初羌乱」耗尽了东汉前期的积蓄。朝中甚至有弃凉州之议，赖虞诩力驳而止。邓后主政期间尚能维持局面，建光元年邓后崩，安帝始得亲政，却立刻诛邓骘等邓氏诸人，转而信用乳母王圣与宦官江京、樊丰等，朝政愈趋壅蔽。

延光三年，安帝废皇太子刘保为济阴王——这个决定为十年后宦官拥立[[e-han-shun|顺帝]]埋下伏笔。延光四年，安帝南巡，崩于叶县，年三十二。阎皇后秘不发丧，与江京等定策立北乡侯[[e-han-shao-bei|刘懿]]，翌年北乡侯薨，宦官孙程等十九人迎立济阴王，东汉由此进入宦官与外戚交替废立的中晚期。史论谓安帝「虽称尊享祀，而令德不终」，其亲政数年，正是东汉政局全面恶化的开始。

> 参考：点校本《后汉书》卷005《孝安帝纪》、《西羌传》、《虞诩传》、《皇后纪》，谭图第 2 册。

bio_parts_en.value: Liu Hu was the son of the filial king Qing of Qinghe. In the first Yanping year, after the death of

, Empress Dowager Deng and her brother Deng Zhi decided behind closed doors to raise the thirteen-year-old Hu as Emperor An. His first fifteen years were the fifteen years of the Deng regency: the Yongchu edicts issued from the Deng house, and An himself was no more than a date in the annals.

His reign's gravest problem was the frontier. In the first Yongchu year the states of the Western Regions turned against Han and the protectorate was abolished; in the second Yongchu year the Xianling Qiang rose in force, Liangzhou was devastated, and year after year troops were raised until the treasury was empty — the "Yongchu Qiang wars" exhausted the accumulated strength of early Eastern Han. There was even a proposal to abandon Liangzhou, rejected only by the arguments of Yu Xu. The Deng regency could still hold the line; but in the first Jianguang year Empress Dowager Deng died, and An, at last ruling in person, at once destroyed Deng Zhi and the Deng house, turning instead to his wet nurse Wang Sheng and the eunuchs Jiang Jing and Fan Feng — the court grew more obstructed than ever.

In the third Yanguang year he deposed Crown Prince Bao as prince of Jiyin — a decision that planted the seed of the eunuch enthronement of

a decade later. In the fourth Yanguang year An died at Ye during a southern tour, aged thirty-two. Empress Yan concealed the death, and with Jiang Jing and others raised the Marquis of Beixiang; when the marquis died the next year, the eunuch Sun Cheng and nineteen others enthroned the prince of Jiyin, and Eastern Han entered its middle-late phase of alternating eunuch and consort usurpation. The historians said of An that "though he sat on the throne and received sacrifice, his good name did not end well"; his years of personal rule mark the beginning of the dynasty's general decay.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Hou Hanshu*, ch. 5 (Benji of Emperor An), the Treatise on the Western Qiang, the biography of Yu Xu, and the Annals of the Empresses; Tan Qixiang's atlas, vol. 2.
